item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 3 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 3 #SLPRSD
Issued at 05:10 PM 11 September 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Masbate(PioV.Corpuz, Esperanza, Placer, Cataingan, Palanas, Dimasalang, Cawayan), #Albay(Malilipot, Bacacay, Polangui), #CamarinesSur(Ocampo, Baao, Nabua, Pili, Bombon and NagaCity) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #NorthernSamar, #Catanduanes, #CamarinesSur(Caramoan, Presentacion, Garchitorena, Lagonoy, SanJose, Goa, Tigaon, Sagñay, Buhi, IrigaCity, Tinambac, Calabanga), #Albay(Tiwi, Malinao and CityOfTabaco) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
